en: A Summer Job at the Bakery

intro.uz: Sardor yozda novvoyxonada ishlaydi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz yozgi taʼtilda ishlab koʻrganmisiz?

paragraphs.en: Last summer, Sardor was seventeen. He wanted to buy a new laptop, but his parents couldn't give him the money. So he decided to find a summer job.
paragraphs.uz: Oʻtgan yozda Sardor oʻn yetti yoshda edi. U yangi noutbuk sotib olmoqchi edi, lekin ota-onasi unga pul bera olmadi. Shuning uchun u yozgi ish topishga qaror qildi.

paragraphs.en: His neighbour, Mr Hamidov, has a small bakery in Bukhara. He needed a helper, and Sardor got the job. He had to start work at five o'clock in the morning, because people buy fresh bread very early.
paragraphs.uz: Qoʻshnisi Hamidovning Buxoroda kichik novvoyxonasi bor. Unga yordamchi kerak edi va Sardor shu ishga kirdi. U ishni ertalab soat beshda boshlashi kerak edi, chunki odamlar yangi nonni juda erta sotib olishadi.

paragraphs.en: The first week was difficult. Sardor was always tired, and once he burned forty loaves of bread! Mr Hamidov wasn't angry. He just laughed and said, "Be more careful next time."
paragraphs.uz: Birinchi hafta qiyin boʻldi. Sardor doim charchagan edi, bir safar esa qirqta nonni kuydirib qoʻydi! Hamidovning jahli chiqmadi. U shunchaki kuldi va: «Keyingi safar ehtiyotkorroq boʻl», — dedi.

paragraphs.en: Slowly, Sardor learned a lot. He could make dough, use the big oven and talk to customers. By the end of August, he had enough money for his laptop.
paragraphs.uz: Asta-sekin Sardor koʻp narsani oʻrgandi. U xamir qora olar, katta tandirdan foydalana olar va xaridorlar bilan gaplasha olardi. Avgust oxiriga kelib, noutbuk uchun yetarli pulga ega boʻldi.

paragraphs.en: Now Sardor is back at school, but he still visits the bakery on Sundays. He says that the job taught him two things: to get up early and to work hard. Next summer, he is going to work there again.
paragraphs.uz: Hozir Sardor yana maktabda oʻqiyapti, lekin yakshanba kunlari hamon novvoyxonaga boradi. Uning aytishicha, bu ish unga ikki narsani oʻrgatdi: erta turishni va qattiq mehnat qilishni. Kelasi yozda u yana oʻsha yerda ishlamoqchi.
